historical_record.description: Cahill Bros. took the general contract for a three-storey reinforced-concrete printing plant for the Abbott-Brady & Sunset Printing Co.
The Abbott Building here was among the quarters the federal government had leased and remodeled for war activities, for the U.S. Army Postal Censor, the Mayor's annual report for 1942 recorded.
